svg.title: Jupiter's contribution orbits, Dec 1, 2025 to Nov 1, 2026
svg.desc: 2998 contributions across 154 active days. Each orbit is one month, oldest inside and newest outside. One star represents one day; brighter and larger stars represent more contributions. Days run clockwise from the upper right. Future days are not drawn.

g.text: Days move clockwise from the upper right.
